# Mamma & Mia Cakes And Catering

## About
Mamma & Mia Cakes And Catering is an artisan bakery in North West, South Africa, founded by Lety Gibbon in 2012. We craft custom celebration cakes, provide corporate catering, operate a daily bakery counter, and offer custom cake consultations. Every item is baked fresh daily using family recipes and local ingredients.

## Services
- Celebration Cakes: Custom-designed birthday cakes, wedding cakes, and special occasion cakes with complimentary tasting consultations
- Corporate Catering: Continental breakfast platters, lunchtime savoury trays, and afternoon tea boxes delivered warm to offices
- Daily Bakery Counter: Fresh cheese rolls, cinnamon buns, and classic Victoria sponge, stocked from 7am daily
- Custom Cake Consultation: Personalized planning sessions for dream cakes with guidance on flavours, fillings, and designs

## Location
North West, South Africa
Serving within a 25km radius for deliveries
